violations.description: Duties of person in charge. — --Person in charge did not ensure employee compliance with an aspect of the food service operation specified in the food service code. When asked if employee washes her hands before putting on gloves, she said no. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves. Certified food manager should ensure employees know when handwashing is required.
Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Hot dogs in beer cooler were found not date marked. Potentially hazardous foods should be date marked.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Facility does not have a probe thermometer for checking internal temperatures. Internal food temperatures should be checked before food items are served.
